metadata.technology_specification: Man-portable thermal imaging sight (monocular or binocular)
metadata.technology_reasoning: Man-portable thermal imaging sights are standardized as lightweight, handheld or weapon-mounted devices incorporating uncooled or cooled infrared detectors to provide thermal imaging capability for military and law enforcement. Their portability and reliability have driven widespread adoption in this form factor with production volume dominance.

components.component: Infrared Detector Module (Uncooled microbolometer or Cooled InSb/FPAs)
components.reasoning: Core sensing component responsible for detecting thermal radiation; always a separate, highly specialized module.

components.component: Optical Assembly (Lens and IR Optical Elements)
components.reasoning: Includes germanium or chalcogenide lenses optimized for infrared wavelengths, essential for focusing thermal energy onto the detector.

components.component: Image Processing Electronics and Digital Signal Processor (DSP) Board
components.reasoning: Processes raw sensor data into usable thermal images; typically a dedicated electronic board with critical firmware/software.
Presents the thermal image to the user, integrated as a discrete component.

components.component: Power Supply Module (Rechargeable Battery Pack or Battery Holder)
components.reasoning: Provides portable power, usually standardized as interchangeable rechargeable battery assemblies or battery packs.

components.component: User Interface Controls and Housing Assembly
components.reasoning: Includes buttons, knobs, switches, and the ergonomically designed casing that contains and protects all components; typically procured or manufactured as a distinct unit.

components.component: Thermal Management System (Heatsinks or Thermoelectric Coolers)
components.reasoning: Present in cooled detector variants for temperature stabilization; may be integrated or separate depending on design complexity.
